title: Phyllosilicate-rich delta deposits in Jezero crater
summary: Fe/Mg- and Al-rich clay minerals mapped in the Jezero western delta, targets for Perseverance sample collection.

evidence.citation: Ehlmann et al. (2008), Nature Geoscience - clay minerals in the Nili Fossae/Jezero region; NASA/JPL Perseverance mission reports

title: Long-lived lacustrine environment in Gale crater
summary: Fine-grained sedimentary rocks at Yellowknife Bay record an ancient lake with neutral-pH chemistry.

evidence.citation: Grotzinger et al. (2014), Science 343 - A habitable fluvio-lacustrine environment at Yellowknife Bay, Gale crater

title: Recurring Slope Lineae in Palikir crater
summary: Dark seasonal flows on warm steep slopes; formation mechanism remains debated (brine vs dry granular).

evidence.citation: McEwen et al. (2011), Science 333 - Seasonal flows on warm Martian slopes

title: Bright basal reflector beneath Ultimi Scopuli ice
summary: Basal returns interpreted by some as liquid water; interpretation is actively debated in the literature.

evidence.citation: Orosei et al. (2018), Science 361 - Radar evidence of subglacial liquid water (interpretation contested)

title: Seasonal methane variation in Gale crater
summary: Background methane shows strong seasonal modulation; trace spikes observed on some sols.

evidence.citation: Webster et al. (2018), Science 360 - Background levels of methane show strong seasonal anomalies

title: Organic molecules in 3-billion-year-old mudstone
summary: Thiophenic, aromatic and aliphatic compounds released from Murray formation mudstones.

evidence.citation: Eigenbrode et al. (2018), Science 360 - Organic matter preserved in 3-billion-year-old mudstones

title: Chloride-bearing mid-latitude deposits
summary: Hundreds of chloride salt outcrops mapped in the southern highlands, evidence of evaporitic settings.

evidence.citation: Osterloo et al. (2010), JGR Planets - Chloride-bearing materials in the southern highlands of Mars

title: Glacier-like forms across the mid-latitudes
summary: Thousands of viscous flow features (lobate debris aprons, tongue-shaped glaciers) record Amazonian ice.

evidence.citation: Souness & Hubbard (2012), JGR Planets - An inventory and characterization of glacier-like forms on Mars

title: Interior layered deposits with sulfates in Valles Marineris
summary: Kieserite and other hydrated sulfates detected in Candor and other canyon interior layered deposits.

evidence.citation: Gendrin et al. (2005), Science 307 - Sulfates in Martian layered terrains: the OMEGA/Mars Express view

title: Gullies on crater walls
summary: Alcove-channel-fan gully landforms on steep slopes; initially proposed as water-related, mechanisms debated.

evidence.citation: Malin & Edgett (2000), Science 288 - Evidence for recent groundwater seepage and surface runoff on Mars

title: Marsquakes localized at Cerberus Fossae
summary: The majority of detected marsquakes originate from the Cerberus Fossae graben system.

evidence.citation: Giardini et al. (2020), Nature Geoscience - Seismicity of Mars; InSight mission reports

title: Hydrous terrain indicators in Utopia Planitia
summary: Zhurong rover observations of terrain in Utopia interpreted as related to past aqueous activity.

evidence.citation: Liu et al. (2022), Nature - Zhurong rover observations of Utopia Planitia

title: Consensus subsurface ice mapping (SWIM)
summary: Aggregated radar, geomorphic, thermal and neutron evidence for shallow ice across the mid-latitudes.

title: Hematite 'blueberry' concretions at Meridiani Planum
summary: Spherical hematite concretions and sulfate sandstones record an ancient evaporite environment.

evidence.citation: Squyres et al. (2004), Science 306 - Opportunity at Meridiani Planum

title: Gediz Vallis Ridge debris-flow deposits
summary: Curiosity imaged and drove through boulder-rich ridges interpreted as debris flows from Mt Sharp's upper slopes.

evidence.citation: NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS mission updates (2023-2024) on Gediz Vallis Ridge
